definitions.explanation: Something that causes difficulty or is not favorable. Often used when a schedule, situation, or condition does not work well.
Something morally questionable or socially unacceptable. Often used in formal or business contexts for misconduct or scandalous behavior.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{不都合|ふつごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: That day is inconvenient, so let's choose another day.

examples.japanese: ご{不都合|ふつごう}な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ございましたら→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please let us know if there is anything inconvenient.

examples.japanese: {不都合|ふつごう}な⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧{不都合|ふつごう}なこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧らしい。
examples.english: It seems he has something improper going on.

examples.japanese: {不都合|ふつごう}な⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発覚|はっかく}して→発覚する：15423_hakkakusuru⟧、⟦{辞任|じにん}→辞任：10144_jinin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれた→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧。
examples.english: Improper conduct was discovered, and he was forced to resign.

notes:
Combines {不|ふ} (not) + ⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧ (convenience, circumstances). Functions both as a na-adjective ({不都合|ふつごう}な) and as a noun ({不都合|ふつごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧). The word carries a slightly formal tone and is common in business and polite speech.

USAGE:
Sense 1 is straightforward — something is inconvenient or unsuitable. Sense 2 has a euphemistic quality: calling something {不都合|ふつごう} often implies wrongdoing or scandal without stating it directly, as in the common phrase {不都合|ふつごう}な⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧ (inconvenient truth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {不都合|ふつごう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ — there is an inconvenience
- {不都合|ふつごう}な⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ — an inconvenient point
- {不都合|ふつごう}な⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧ — an inconvenient fact
- ご{不都合|ふつごう} — inconvenience (polite)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{都合|つごう}が{悪|わる}い→都合が悪い：22996_tsugougawarui⟧ — inconvenient; the more colloquial way to express the same idea
- ⟦{不便|ふべん}→不便：01501_fuben⟧ — inconvenient; focuses on practical difficulty rather than suitability
